elevate.move: Turn the drawn tiles into one job told in sequence (raked joint, three test panels, chosen panel, tooled concave joint, finished front) so every illustration is a stage of the same wall and the drawings read as one case file.

Compose the phone hero on its own: one full-width test-panel A/B/C drawing under the h1, and carry the header/stretcher bond rhythm into the sticky bar so the signature survives at 390 instead of three truncated thumbnails.
